tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't pay anything, because Evergreen Catering (V-764) has two approved invoices, not one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-54311 | $1,794.66 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-64706 | $5,952.39 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices aren't payable: INV-26736 is already paid, and INV-43342 is a draft still waiting for approval. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

You asked for one invoice paid exactly once, and a wire can't easily be undone. I didn't want to guess which one you meant. Please tell me which to pay: INV-54311, INV-64706 or both. Each is under the $10,000 limit, so controller approval isn't needed even if I pay both. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), using a set ID so it can't go through twice, and report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-64706, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-64706, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I've paid INV-64706 in full by wire, and it went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-64706 (Evergreen Catering, V-764), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $5,952.39 from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent, and the invoice now shows as paid.

I checked the account afterward and PAY0001 is the only payment on it. No controller approval was needed because the amount is under $10,000.

As you asked, I didn't pay INV-54311 ($1,794.66). It still shows as approved and has nothing in its memo about the dispute, so it could get paid by mistake later. You may want to put it on hold or add a note about the dispute in the system.
